criteria.reason: The candidate matches the assigned STUDY_005 objective.
The fixture states 'Prior context contains a material contradiction' but omits any actual concrete facts or conflicting records in confirmed_facts or prior context text.
The single input prompt directly targets the unresolved course identity without asking irrelevant filler questions.
The UI component uses 'entity_picker', which is explicitly permitted in the V2 allow-list.
The candidate sets up the V2 output structure (course_capabilities, practical_components, unknowns, next_actions) and focuses on curriculum unit/capability mapping.
No curriculum facts or fake units were invented; unknown status is preserved accurately.
No unvalidated psychological or career success probability claims were made.
The candidate correctly halted at NEEDS_INPUT rather than hallucinating course details or asking redundant questions.
Readiness is appropriately disabled/blocked on the missing course selection rather than outputting a speculative readiness score.
Compact semantic handoff envelope is properly populated with result, unknowns, and recommended next action.
Emits safe, structured next actions with no direct unauthorized external endpoint calls or writes.

fixture_limitations: Fixture omitted concrete conflicting facts in confirmed_facts, supplying only a placeholder description ('Prior context contains a material contradiction.'), preventing direct assessment of specific fact reuse.
parsed.summary: The candidate correctly stops to resolve missing course information using the allowed V2 entity_picker primitive, preserves unknowns cleanly, and adheres to evidence discipline.
